instructions.original_snippets: NEVER rely only on ShellCheck for validation
instructions.content: Never treat a clean ShellCheck run as sufficient; it is static analysis and does not execute the script, so runtime failures (missing files, permissions, exit codes) can still slip through.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER disable ShellCheck rules globally with a file-level directive
instructions.content: Never add a file-level shellcheck disable directive; it silences every future violation of that rule, not just the intended one.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER treat POSIX sh and bash scripts identically
instructions.content: Never validate a #!/bin/sh script as if it were bash; POSIX sh lacks arrays, [[ ]], and $(()) arithmetic, and bash-only syntax fails silently on strict sh implementations.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER use exit 0 or || true to suppress error propagation
instructions.content: Never flag exit 0 or || true as harmless; either one breaks set -e propagation and hides a real failure from the caller.

instructions.original_snippets: For EACH issue found: show the problematic code, explain the issue, provide the corrected code, explain why the fix improves the script
instructions.content: For every issue found, follow the four-part format: show the problem, explain it, show the fix, explain why the fix helps.

instructions.original_snippets: Custom security checks: unsafe eval, command injection, rm -rf, unquoted variables
instructions.content: Run custom security checks beyond ShellCheck: unsafe eval, command injection via unvalidated variables, unquoted rm -rf targets.

instructions.original_snippets: Custom portability checks: bashisms in sh scripts
instructions.content: Check scripts declared as #!/bin/sh for bash-only constructs (declare -a, local, [[ ]], array operations) that will fail on strict POSIX sh.

instructions.original_snippets: Summary generation: color-coded report with counts
instructions.content: End the response with a summary of error, warning, and info counts and a clear pass/fail verdict.

instructions.original_snippets: Automatic shell detection from shebang determines validation dialect
instructions.content: Detect the shell dialect from the shebang before validating, since bash-specific and POSIX-sh checks are not interchangeable.

instructions.original_snippets: Add per-line suppressions only where the behavior is intentional and documented
instructions.content: When a ShellCheck warning is a deliberate, correct choice, suppress it per line with a reason comment rather than globally.
